In a typical week, you might reset a password, deploy a laptop, support warehouse technology, patch a Windows Server, reconfigure wireless access, work with a vendor, and lead a practical AI training session. The IT Administrator will be the first point of contact when technology issues arise and will be expected to own problems through resolution. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Help Desk & End-User Support Serve as the primary contact for technology requests involving accounts, computers, printers, phones, connectivity, and related issues. Troubleshoot desktops, laptops, tablets, mobile devices, and peripherals. Configure and deploy equipment for new hires, transfers, and refresh cycles. Support warehouse technology including barcode scanners, label printers, RF devices, kiosks, and WMS workstations. Maintain useful documentation and coordinate with vendors when escalation is needed. Systems, Security & Infrastructure Administer Microsoft 365, including users, licensing, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive. Support Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, VPN, patching, and backups. Support Microsoft Defender and Purview and respond to phishing, malware, and other security issues. Support routers, firewalls, switches, structured cabling, wireless access points, internet connectivity, VoIP, and mobile devices. Troubleshoot wireless coverage across more than 60,000 square feet of warehouse and office space. Technology Management Maintain IT asset inventory, warranties, licensing, renewals, and lifecycle planning. Coordinate repairs, vendor support, and technology improvements. AI ENABLEMENT & TRAINING A meaningful part of this role is helping employees and clients adopt AI tools safely and effectively. Deliver hands-on AI training, coaching, small-group sessions, and lunch-and-learns for users with varying technical experience. Facilitate practical “AI jam sessions” that identify repetitive work and use prompting and AI tools to solve real business problems. Create quick-reference guides, prompt libraries, and short tutorials. Reinforce appropriate use of company and customer information in AI tools. Travel locally to client and outsourced operating locations in the DFW metro as needed. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of experience in IT support, systems administration, or a combined help desk/administrator role. Hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 and Windows Server environments. Working knowledge of routing, switching, firewalls, VPN, Wi-Fi, DNS, and structured cabling. Demonstrated ability to train, present, onboard, or coach users through new technology. Training is a core function of this position. Genuine curiosity about AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Gemini, or similar platforms, with the ability to explain their strengths and limitations in plain language. Strong customer-service skills and patience with nontechnical users. Ability to work independently and prioritize competing demands. Valid Texas driver’s license, reliable personal vehicle, and acceptable driving record for local travel; mileage is reimbursed. Ability to pass a background check and lift up to 50 pounds. You are not expected to know every platform on day one, but you should be comfortable learning new systems quickly. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, paid time off, mileage reimbursement for business travel, and company-supported professional development including certification study and exam reimbursement. We are committed to consistently delivering value-adding services, and we do this through our greatest asset: our employees. On-Target Supplies & Logistics, Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

review_candidates.description: Job Title: Linux System Administrator Job Category: Information Technology Time Type: Full time Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None Employee Type: Regular Percentage of Travel Required: None Type of Travel: None * * * The Opportunity CACI is searching for a Linux System Administrator to support the FEMA Office of the Chief Information Security Officer (OCISO) in Washington, D.C. As a Linux System Administrator, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the security and operational resilience of FEMA's Linux-based infrastructure. You will work in a dynamic environment, collaborating with cybersecurity professionals, system owners, and enterprise administrators to implement and maintain secure server configurations across on-premises and hybrid environments. Your efforts will directly contribute to safeguarding FEMA's mission-critical systems and data. The Linux System Administrator will be responsible for securing Linux-based infrastructure supporting system reliability, hardening, patching, logging, and assessment readiness across on-premises and hybrid environments. This position requires leveraging DISA STIGs or CIS Benchmarks to reduce attack surfaces and implement security controls and configurations. The Linux System Administrator will configure firewalls, access controls, and harden system services while performing regular patching, software upgrades, and hotfixes on Linux servers. This role ensures high availability and uptime through proactive monitoring of system performance, health, and capacity. Responsibilities The Linux System Administrator will secure Linux-based infrastructure for the FEMA enterprise and leverage DISA STIGs or CIS Benchmarks to reduce attack surfaces while implementing security controls and configurations across Linux systems. This position requires configuring firewalls, access controls, and hardening system services, as well as performing regular patching, software upgrades, and hotfixes on Linux servers. The Linux System Administrator will remediate vulnerabilities and ensure system integrity while planning and testing patches to avoid operational disruptions. Responsibilities include ensuring high availability and uptime for mission-critical systems, proactively monitoring system performance, health, and capacity, and supporting business continuity requirements. The position involves implementing redundancy measures and preventing system failures, managing user identities, authentication, and authorization, and supporting ICAM tools, LDAP, and privileged access management. The Linux System Administrator will implement principle of least privilege and maintain system logging for auditing and compliance. This position requires supporting vulnerability remediation and conducting security assessments while researching and maintaining proficiency in tools, techniques, countermeasures, and trends in computer and network vulnerabilities, data hiding, and network and device security and encryption. The Linux System Administrator will maintain technical documentation for all administrative actions. Qualifications U.S. Citizenship required FEMA EOD suitability or Current DHS or FEMA EOD preferred BS/BA + 8 years of applicable experience or equivalent combination Minimum 7 years of experience in Linux system administration Demonstrated expertise in Linux infrastructure, DISA STIGs, and CIS Benchmarks Experience with security hardening and vulnerability remediation Knowledge of firewalls, access controls, and system service hardening Experience with LDAP, PAM, and identity management solutions Experience with DISA STIGs and security hardening best practices Knowledge of vulnerability remediation and patch management processes Strong understanding of Linux security logging and auditing Experience with VXRails or Zscaler Desired Previous DHS or DoD experience Experience with shell scripting (bash, python) and automation Knowledge of configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef) Experience with hybrid cloud environments (AWS, Azure) Familiarity with ICAM tools and privileged access management Experience supporting 24/7 operations and disaster recovery What You Can Expect A culture of integrity. At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation. An environment of trust. CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality. A focus on continuous growth. Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy. Pay Range There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits. Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position. The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is $90,300-$189,600 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. review_candidates.title: IT Automation & Support Specialist
review_candidates.description: IT Automation & Support Engineer San Ramon, CA; Reno, NV; NYC About Ridgeline Ridgeline is the first front-to-back system of record for investment managers. Founded by visionary entrepreneur Dave Duffield (co-founder of both PeopleSoft and Workday), the company was created to modernize an industry held back by outdated, disconnected technology. Powered by a single, real-time data set and embedded AI, Ridgeline helps firms automate complexity, accelerate collaboration, and deliver tailored client experiences at scale, without added headcount or risk. Ridgeline is headquartered in Lake Tahoe, with offices in New York, Reno, and the Bay Area, and is recognized by Fast Company as a “Best Workplace for Innovators,” by Frost & Sullivan as a “Technology Innovation Leader,” and by The Software Report as a “Top 100 Software Company.” The role Ridgeline is growing fast, and that growth lands hard on IT. Rather than adding a person every time ticket volume climbs, we're building the automation and AI tooling that lets a small team support a lot more people. This role does two things. It builds the backend automation — Okta Workflows, Jira Automation, Atlassian Rovo — that resolves repetitive tickets before they reach a person. And a few days a week, it provides hands-on, in-person support at the office. Both parts matter, and we're looking for someone who's good at each and actually enjoys both. About The Team We work in sprints with scoped projects, and we put real effort into automating repetitive work so the team can spend its time on problems that need a person. Sprint work runs alongside the day-to-day support and ticket queue that keep the offices running, so you'll do both. The team spans several offices, weighted toward the West Coast, with room to grow on the East Coast. Wherever you sit, the problem is the same: how do we scale support without just scaling headcount? What You'll Do Automation & AI infrastructure Build and maintain automations for repetitive work like access management and laptop inventory. Develop automation pipelines in Okta Workflows and Jira Automation. Build agentic workflows in Atlassian Rovo: creating skills, improving the inputs the AI learns from, and expanding automated ticket deflection. Plan and scope work with the team on sprint cycles. In-office support Provide hands-on, in-person support at your office. Handle Tier 1 and Tier 2 support: laptop provisioning, account lifecycle, and everyday employee IT needs. Be the local go-to, so the rest of the team can stay focused on project work. Your first 90 days By 30 days: you understand how our systems and processes work today, and where they break down. By 60 days: you have enough context to weigh in on team projects and priorities. By 90 days: you're running sprint work, improving processes, and applying your automation experience to real problems. Beyond that, you'll help level up the wider team and keep in-office support at a consistently high bar. What We're Looking For 3–5 years in IT operations or system administration. Demonstrated experience actually building automations, not just using them. Comfort scripting in Python or Bash. Hands-on Okta experience (user and app provisioning, security policies). Experience managing Mac fleets and platforms like Jamf, Google Workspace, and Atlassian. Genuine comfort moving between backend technical work and in-person support. This is a true hybrid role, not a path to settling on one side. A bias toward improving things rather than just keeping them running. Nice to have Hands-on experience with AI and agentic tooling (Rovo, Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) in IT workflows. Certifications in Okta, Jamf (200), or Microsoft/Azure. A working understanding of secure API usage and integrations. Real enthusiasm for the in-person, employee-facing side of IT. Compensation And Benefits The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is $104,000 - $131,000. Final compensation amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amount listed above. As an employee at Ridgeline, you’ll have many opportunities for advancement in your career and can make a true impact on the product. In addition to the base salary, Ridgeline employees can participate in our Company Stock Plan subject to the applicable Stock Option Agreement. We also offer rich benefits that reflect the kind of organization we want to be: one in which our employees feel valued and are inspired to bring their best selves to work. These include unlimited vacation, educational and wellness reimbursements, and $0 cost employee insurance plans. Please check out our Careers page for a more comprehensive overview of our perks and benefits. Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement Our company does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non-merit factor. Candidate Privacy Ridgeline processes the information you submit in connection with your application in accordance with the Ridgeline Candidate Privacy Policy. Please review the Ridgeline Candidate Privacy Policy in full to understand our privacy practices and contact us with any questions. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

review_candidates.title: Ingénieur réseaux et systèmes
review_candidates.description: Fondée en 2014, Deepki est la solution SaaS de référence en matière de durabilité dans le secteur immobilier. Elle accompagne les acteurs de l'immobilier tertiaire dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs de durabilité grâce à un logiciel innovant et à des services d'expertise. La plateforme Deepki permet une prise de décision éclairée, au service de l'impact climatique et de la performance opérationnelle des portefeuilles immobiliers. Notre marque repose sur trois valeurs fortes : " Trust, Care & Act " (confiance, bienveillance et engagement), qui guident nos relations, notre fonctionnement et notre impact. Nos équipes impliquées s'engagent à accompagner nos clients vers la réussite en leur fournissant des données fiables et des analyses concrètes, vectrices de changement durable. Nous recherchons un profil Ingénieur.e Systèmes & Réseaux IT : vous serez la colonne vertébrale de notre infrastructure et de nos services IT à l’échelle internationale. Votre mission : garantir une excellence opérationnelle pour l'ensemble de nos collaborateurs, en bureaux comme en remote. Poste en CDI à pourvoir dès que possible - basé à Paris - Présentiel - modèle hybride dans un second temps Salaire annuel: 48-51K€ Le poste: 60 % Administration systèmes & infra / 40 % Support IT & expérience utilisateur Administration Systèmes & Infrastructure (60%) Gestion du parc & infrastructures : Configurer, administrer et monitorer l'infrastructure IT pour garantir la sécurité, la disponibilité et la fiabilité des services. Piloter et sécuriser la flotte principalement macOS via MDM (Kandji/Jamf) : profils de configuration, déploiement de logiciels et politiques de mise à jour. Gestion du cycle de vie du matériel : Gérer le cycle complet des équipements (approvisionnement, configuration, déploiement, déclassement). Maintenir un inventaire précis des actifs IT (Asset Registry) pour le matériel, les licences et les appareils IoT. Conformité & gestion des vulnérabilités : suivre les comportements des endpoints et les vulnérabilités via notre EDR (SentinelOne). Identifier et corriger les risques de sécurité en coordination avec l'équipe Sécurité. Assurer le respect des cycles de patchs (OS et logiciels) et générer les rapports de conformité pour les audits. Politiques de sécurité & IAM : Implémenter les intégrations SSO avec les plateformes SaaS via Okta (ou outil équivalent). Gérer la gestion des accès basés sur les rôles (RBAC), ainsi que le provisioning/déprovisionning des services Cloud. Collaborer avec l'équipe Sécurité pour appliquer les politiques de sécurité IT. Projets & documentation : Piloter ou contribuer aux projets d'infrastructure pour scaler nos opérations. Rédiger et maintenir à jour les runbooks IT, rapports techniques, process et proposer des améliorations (upgrades d'outils, initiatives de standardisation). Support IT & Opérations (40%) Support technique (N1/N2/N3) : Être le point de contact principal (Help Desk) pour toutes les demandes et incidents matériel, logiciel, réseau et systèmes. Résoudre les incidents complexes de niveau 3 en autonomie et en lien avec les fournisseurs ou équipes d'ingénierie. Suivre les SLAs (réponse/résolution) et analyser les données pour apporter des corrections durables. Garantir la qualité du ticketing (catégorisation, reporting de performance). Onboarding et expérience utilisateurs : Gérer le cycle technique complet d'onboarding (provisioning machine, création de comptes, accès) et d'offboarding (révocations des accès, récupération du matériel, archivage conforme). Assurer le support multi-régions (plusieurs pays et fuseaux horaires) et animer les sessions d'accueil IT et créer des supports pour les utilisateurs (FAQ…). Environnement de travail et administration SaaS : Administrer la stack d'outils (Google Workspace, Slack, M365, Jira/Confluence) : gestion des utilisateurs, groupes et intégrations. Office IT & Équipements : Configurer et maintenir le matériel audiovisuel des salles de réunion (caméras, Zoom Rooms, hubs USB/HDMI). Gérer le stock et le prêt de périphériques (écrans, claviers, casques) pour le présentiel et le remote. Assurer la disponibilité des imprimantes et bornes Wi-Fi. Profil: 3 ans minimum d'expérience en Opérations IT ou Support, idéalement en start-up / scale-up. Expérience avérée dans la gestion d'environnements multi-sites et internationaux (bureaux et remote). Capacité de collaboration transverse au quotidien avec les équipes People, Finance, Sales et Operations. Expertise macOS & MDM : maîtrise de l'écosystème Apple et outils MDM (Kandji/Jamf) : profils, politiques et scripting. Scripting obligatoire : maîtrise de Shell et/ou Python pour l'automatisation de l'administration et de la gestion de flotte. Outils cloud & IAM : Administration courante de Google Workspace, gestion des outils SaaS et des plateformes IAM/SSO (Okta ou équivalent). Réseau & sécurité : Bonnes bases en fondamentaux réseaux, bonnes pratiques de sécurité et workflows de gestion des vulnérabilités / outils EDR (SentinelOne idéalement). Esprit analytique et rigueur pour diagnostiquer méthodiquement les problèmes complexes. Grand sens du service, forte autonomie, culture du détail et proactivité dans la communication. Capacité à gérer de front plusieurs priorités concurrentes. Français courant obligatoire - Anglais technique courant indispensable (contexte international, équipes multi-pays). Poste sensible: Oui Les postes sensibles correspondent aux catégories d’employés pouvant accéder à des données sensibles dans le cadre de leurs missions. Notre engagement : Chez Deepki , nous sommes convaincus que la diversité est une force. En tant qu'employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances, nous étudions chaque candidature avec la même attention, sans distinction d'origine, de religion, de genre, d'orientation sexuelle, d'âge ou de handicap. Nos décisions de recrutement sont fondées exclusivement sur les compétences, la motivation et les besoins de l'entreprise. Deepki : #ImpactForward

review_candidates.title: Cloud and Automation Engineer
review_candidates.description: The Opportunity: Mesirow is an independent, employee-owned financial services firm founded in 1937. Headquartered in Chicago, with offices around the world, we serve clients through a personal, custom approach to reaching financial goals and acting as a force for social good. With capabilities spanning Private Capital & Currency, Capital Markets & Investment Banking, and Advisory Services, we invest in what matters: our clients, our communities and our culture. We are proud of our employee-owned culture, built on collaboration and shared success, empowering our professionals to develop meaningful relationships, pursue growth opportunities and make a lasting impact for our clients and communities. Mesirow has been named one of the Best Places to Work in Chicago by Crain’s Chicago Business multiple times and is one of Barron’s Top 100 RIA firms. The Cloud and Infrastructure team owns and operates the systems that power the business: Azure, on-premises hyperconverged infrastructure, and the networking and telephony that connect them. We are growing the team to reduce single points of ownership, build deeper coverage across our platforms, and shift more of our work from manual support toward engineering, automation, and self-service. We're looking for a Cloud and Automation Engineer who thinks in systems, not just tools. You should be comfortable moving between cloud and on-premises environments, understand how infrastructure, identity, networking, and applications depend on one another, and be driven to replace repetitive manual work with code and process. You'll work as part of cross-functional squads alongside engineering, security, and business partners, so strong collaboration and communication matter as much as technical depth. This role is well suited to someone who has built real depth in systems and cloud engineering, who is genuinely energized by learning new platforms and approaches, and who wants to help mature a team's practices rather than just execute a backlog. This role is on a hybrid schedule, with office presence expected two days per week Responsibilities: Design, build, and operate infrastructure across Azure and on-premises hyperconverged environments, applying consistent engineering principles regardless of platform. Automate provisioning, configuration, and operational tasks using infrastructure-as-code practices, reducing manual and repetitive work across the environment. Partner with cross-functional squads to translate business and application requirements into resilient, secure, and maintainable infrastructure designs. Co-design systems and platforms with application developers, favoring immutable infrastructure patterns so environments are consistently rebuilt from code rather than patched or drifted over time. Contribute to the evolution of our hybrid cloud strategy: helping decide what belongs in the private data center versus Azure, and building the automation that makes those workloads portable and consistently managed. Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues that span cloud, virtualization, storage, networking, and identity layers. Establish and document standards, patterns, and runbooks that reduce tribal knowledge and make systems easier for the team to support. Embed SRE principles and engineering practices into how systems are built and how the team works day to day, favoring measurable reliability, proactive detection, and repeatable process over reactive firefighting. Identify opportunities to insource work currently handled by external managed-service partners, and build the automation and monitoring needed to support it internally. Contribute to shifting the team's focus away from bespoke, hand-managed infrastructure and toward *aaS models and reusable, codified platforms, freeing capacity to focus on the systems that enable differentiated business capabilities. Participate in an on-call rotation and incident response, contributing to root-cause analysis and durable fixes rather than one-off remediation. Stay current with evolving cloud, virtualization, and automation practices, and bring new approaches back to the team. Requirements: Experience A solution-oriented systems engineering mindset, paired with continuous improvement and being easy to work with across teams. 5-10 years of demonstrated experience integrating and automating infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code approaches, in a public cloud (Azure preferred) and in a virtualized or hyperconverged on-premises environment. A track record of solving problems that cross multiple layers of the stack, not just working within a single platform or tool. Experience working in cross-functional or squad-based delivery models, partnering with engineers, architects, and business stakeholders outside your immediate team. Skills and Approach Demonstrated experience with Terraform and Ansible, ideally applied in an Azure environment. Strong grounding in core systems and cloud engineering principles: availability, scalability, security, cost, and operability, and the ability to reason about trade-offs between them. A builder's mindset: default to automating and codifying solutions rather than performing repeated manual work. A drive to optimize and re-engineer processes where it makes sense, rather than simply automating what's done today as-is. Comfort operating across a hybrid environment, understanding how workload placement decisions affect cost, performance, resiliency, and support burden. Strong troubleshooting instincts and the ability to work back from symptoms to root cause across interdependent systems. Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to document designs and standards that other engineers can follow. A genuine appetite for learning: comfortable picking up new platforms, tools, and practices as the environment evolves, rather than anchoring to a fixed toolset. Good judgment about when to build, when to buy, and when to simplify rather than automate around unnecessary complexity. A reuse- and security-first mindset, applied in a way that keeps sight of user and developer experience rather than adding friction for its own sake. Nice to Have Exposure to identity and access management, networking, or telephony systems in addition to core infrastructure. Experience contributing to architecture decisions or documentation (e.g., ADRs) rather than only implementing them. Familiarity with reducing reliance on outsourced managed services through internal automation and tooling. Experience working in a highly regulated financial services environment, including familiarity with the risk, compliance, and change-control expectations common there. In accordance with the Illinois Pay Transparency Law, the anticipated hiring base salary for the role will be between $145,000 and $175,000 per year. However, base pay if hired will be determined on an individualized basis and is only part of the total compensation package, which, also provides the opportunity for a bonus and the Mesirow benefit program. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

The System Engineer II actively monitors system health, troubleshoots complex issues, implements automation to improve efficiency, and ensures compliance with security and regulatory requirements. In addition, this role contributes to documentation, disaster recovery planning, and continuous improvement initiatives while mentoring junior engineers and providing technical leadership in daily operations. ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES: General System Work Collaborates with senior engineers to design and implement systems that meet performance, scalability, availability, and security requirements. Participates in the integration of new systems and upgrades to existing infrastructure. Ensures system designs meet key requirements for availability, performance, and maintainability. Works closely with development, security, and operations teams to ensure systems are aligned with business objectives and meet technical requirements. Participates in system design reviews, offering insights and recommendations based on technical expertise. Performs regular system maintenance tasks such as patch management, updates, and system backups. Ensures systems are properly maintained throughout their lifecycle, managing hardware replacement, software updates, and configuration changes. Contributes to the planning and implementation of system upgrades, ensuring minimal downtime and disruption. System Monitoring and Optimization Actively monitors system health, performance metrics, and system logs, ensuring the systems are operating as expected, identifying areas for improvement, and optimizing configurations to increase system efficiency. Identifies areas for process improvement and suggests solutions to streamline operations and increase reliability. Monitors resource usage of systems to ensure they are sized appropriately and change resource allocation when necessary. Implements automation tools and scripts (e.g., Ansible, PowerShell) to improve system administration tasks and reduce manual intervention. Problem Resolution Troubleshoots complex system issues related to hardware, software, or networking, applying corrective measures to prevent recurrence. Participates in incident response activities, including root cause analysis, resolution, and documentation of issues affecting system availability or performance. Assists junior engineers in solving complex system issues, supporting their development and providing hands-on learning opportunities. Escalates critical issues as appropriate while collaborating with senior engineers for resolution. Security Mindset Implements security protocols such as firewalls, and user authentication to safeguard systems and data. Works with security engineers to ensure systems are compliant with regulatory standards and internal security policies. Applies security patches and updates system configurations to remediate vulnerabilities in accordance with the SLA. Understands certificate and encryption cipher concepts to implement secure connections between systems. Understanding of security concepts such as least privilege and network segmentation. Documentation Practices Maintains detailed documentation of system configurations, changes, and incidents to ensure clarity for team members and future reference. Creates and updates troubleshooting guides, operational procedures, and knowledge base articles to assist in daily operations and knowledge sharing. Disaster Recovery/Backups Ensures that backup schedules are adhered to and that data is correctly stored and easily recoverable in the event of failure. Assists in disaster recovery testing and planning to ensure business continuity. Collaboration/Communication Works with other engineers, business analysts and stakeholders to ensure smooth system implementation and integration. Provides support to other teams during system rollouts or configurations and assists in ensuring system compatibility across different platforms. Reviews the work of junior engineers, offering feedback and suggestions to help them grow technically. Participates in team calls and check-ins, heartbeats, and project kick-offs. Training and Career Growth Mentors Systems Engineer I team members, providing guidance on system configuration, troubleshooting, and best practices. Participates in training sessions, certification programs, and team meetings to grow technical expertise and stay updated on industry best practices. Participates in continuous improvement initiatives, refining procedures and policies for system management and deployment. Seeks feedback and learning opportunities from more experienced team members to improve technical proficiency. Miscellaneous Demonstrate regular and predictable attendance. Complete mandatory company training. Perform other duties as assigned. EDUCATION: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent of education and experience in computer science or related field. EXPERIENCE: A system engineer with 2-5 years of experience in system administration, engineering, or infrastructure support will generally demonstrate these skill sets. OTHER QUALIFICATIONS: Technical Proficiency Advanced experience with a range of tools and technologies, including: Operating Systems: Windows Server and Linux Virtualization & Remote Access: VMware, RDP, SSH Containers: Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, OpenShift Scripting: PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ansible Monitoring Tools: SolarWinds, Prometheus Version Control: Git Job Schedulers: Cron, Zena Security: Encryption, firewalls, ACLs, multi-factor authentication, vulnerability management Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, VLANs, routing Backup & Recovery: Enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions Professional Attributes Strong analytical thinker with the ability to break down moderately complex problems and identify practical solutions. Clear written and verbal communication with the ability to present technical issues and solutions. Strong communicator and collaborator, able to work with cross-functional teams including business units, development, operations, and security. Capable of undertaking tasks with limited guidance from senior engineers. Proficient in creating and maintaining documentation, test plans, and disaster recovery procedures. Mentorship experience or desire to coach junior team members. Proactive mindset with a focus on process optimization. Available to work outside standard hours as needed for changes or upgrades. On-call availability for critical system incidents as needed. May need to live within a 2-hour radius of Acuity’s HQ (depending on job duties). *Acuity does not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization.* This job is classified as exempt. new_matches.title: Information Technology Administrator
new_matches.description: On-Target Supplies & Logistics, Ltd. is seeking an IT Administrator to serve as the primary technology resource for our Dallas corporate office, warehouse operations, and supported client locations throughout the DFW area. This is a broad, hands-on role for someone who enjoys both troubleshooting technology and helping people use it effectively. In a typical week, you might reset a password, deploy a laptop, support warehouse technology, patch a Windows Server, reconfigure wireless access, work with a vendor, and lead a practical AI training session. The IT Administrator will be the first point of contact when technology issues arise and will be expected to own problems through resolution. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Help Desk & End-User Support Serve as the primary contact for technology requests involving accounts, computers, printers, phones, connectivity, and related issues. Troubleshoot desktops, laptops, tablets, mobile devices, and peripherals. Configure and deploy equipment for new hires, transfers, and refresh cycles. Support warehouse technology including barcode scanners, label printers, RF devices, kiosks, and WMS workstations. Maintain useful documentation and coordinate with vendors when escalation is needed. Systems, Security & Infrastructure Administer Microsoft 365, including users, licensing, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive. Support Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, VPN, patching, and backups. Support Microsoft Defender and Purview and respond to phishing, malware, and other security issues. Support routers, firewalls, switches, structured cabling, wireless access points, internet connectivity, VoIP, and mobile devices. Troubleshoot wireless coverage across more than 60,000 square feet of warehouse and office space. Technology Management Maintain IT asset inventory, warranties, licensing, renewals, and lifecycle planning. Coordinate repairs, vendor support, and technology improvements. AI ENABLEMENT & TRAINING A meaningful part of this role is helping employees and clients adopt AI tools safely and effectively. Deliver hands-on AI training, coaching, small-group sessions, and lunch-and-learns for users with varying technical experience. Facilitate practical “AI jam sessions” that identify repetitive work and use prompting and AI tools to solve real business problems. Create quick-reference guides, prompt libraries, and short tutorials. Reinforce appropriate use of company and customer information in AI tools. Travel locally to client and outsourced operating locations in the DFW metro as needed. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of experience in IT support, systems administration, or a combined help desk/administrator role. Hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 and Windows Server environments. Working knowledge of routing, switching, firewalls, VPN, Wi-Fi, DNS, and structured cabling. Demonstrated ability to train, present, onboard, or coach users through new technology. Training is a core function of this position. Genuine curiosity about AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Gemini, or similar platforms, with the ability to explain their strengths and limitations in plain language. Strong customer-service skills and patience with nontechnical users. Ability to work independently and prioritize competing demands. Valid Texas driver’s license, reliable personal vehicle, and acceptable driving record for local travel; mileage is reimbursed. Ability to pass a background check and lift up to 50 pounds. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience in a 3PL, warehouse, distribution, or manufacturing environment is a plus, along with familiarity with WMS/TMS platforms, Microsoft security tools, ISO 9001, training, or relevant CompTIA/Microsoft certifications. OUR TECHNOLOGY ENVIRONMENT Our environment includes Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, Windows Server, Defender and Purview, SharePoint and OneDrive, cloud VoIP, wireless networking, business systems, and a growing set of AI tools. You are not expected to know every platform on day one, but you should be comfortable learning new systems quickly. WORK ENVIRONMENT & COMPENSATION This is an on-site position based at our Dallas corporate office with occasional travel to client locations throughout the DFW metro. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required for maintenance, cutovers, or migrations. Salary: $65,000–$75,000 annually, based on experience and demonstrated technical and training ability. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, paid time off, mileage reimbursement for business travel, and company-supported professional development including certification study and exam reimbursement. WHY ON-TARGET On-Target Supplies & Logistics, Ltd., is a regional supply chain logistics management firm with global customers and international responsibilities. For more than 40 years, we have worked with some of the largest companies in the world to design, implement, and manage customized logistics and transportation solutions that help them to gain a competitive advantage in today's global marketplace. We are committed to consistently delivering value-adding services, and we do this through our greatest asset: our employees. On-Target Supplies & Logistics, Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

As a Windows System Administrator, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the security and operational resilience of FEMA's Windows-based infrastructure. You will work in a dynamic environment, collaborating with cybersecurity professionals, system owners, and enterprise administrators to implement and maintain secure server configurations and identity management solutions. Your efforts will directly contribute to safeguarding FEMA's mission-critical systems and data. The Windows System Administrator will be responsible for securing Windows-based infrastructure supporting operational resilience, hardening, patching, identity management, and control implementation across the FEMA enterprise. This position requires building, hardening, patching, and maintaining Windows servers to ensure they stay updated through consistent patching. The Windows System Administrator will manage user accounts across the FEMA enterprise and manage Group Policy Objects (GPOs) enterprise-wide to enforce security controls and permissions, ensuring consistent security configurations across all Windows systems Responsibilities The Windows System Administrator will build, harden, patch, and maintain Windows servers across the FEMA enterprise and ensure servers stay updated through consistent patching to maintain operational resilience. This position requires implementing security configurations and applying security patches promptly while ensuring compliance with DISA STIGs and agency-specific security requirements. The Windows System Administrator will manage user accounts across the FEMA enterprise and manage Group Policy Objects (GPOs) enterprise-wide to enforce security controls and permissions, ensuring consistent security configurations across Windows systems. Responsibilities include handling vulnerability remediation activities for Windows-based systems, managing digital certificates for authentication and encryption, and maintaining system logging for auditing and compliance. The position involves supporting ICAM (Identity, Credential, and Access Management) requirements and executing recovery processes to ensure business continuity. The Windows System Administrator will maintain technical documentation for all administrative actions and perform logging, certificates, and recovery processes. Qualifications U.S. Citizenship required FEMA EOD suitability or Current DHS or FEMA EOD preferred BS/BA + 8 years of applicable experience or equivalent combination Minimum 7 years of experience in Windows system administration Demonstrated expertise in Windows Server infrastructure, Active Directory, and Group Policy Experience with DISA STIGs and security hardening best practices Knowledge of vulnerability remediation and patch management processes Experience with identity and access management systems Strong understanding of Windows security logging and auditing Experience with VXRails or Zscaler. Desired Active Secret security clearance Previous DHS or DoD experience with classified systems Knowledge of certificate management and PKI infrastructure Experience with disaster recovery and business continuity planning Familiarity with ICAM tools and privileged access management Experience other cybersecurity-related tools and systems Cloud security experience with AWS, Azure, or other platforms Experience with automated security tools and scripting What You Can Expect A culture of integrity. At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation. An environment of trust. CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality. A focus on continuous growth. Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy. Pay Range There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits. Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position. The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is $90,300-$189,600 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

new_matches.title: Network Security Engineer - Network Access Control
new_matches.description: Job Description: At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us! Job Description: The Network Security Engineer is responsible for supporting multiple security engineering efforts to deliver enterprise security capabilities. Key responsibilities include serving as a subject matter expert of security technology, overseeing major engineering milestones including the design, development, and implementation of systems, and reporting on key metrics. Job expectations include executing on engineering initiatives, partnering with cross-functional teams, solving complex issues within BofA's global network footprint. Responsibilities: Identify gaps in environment management standards adherence and work with appropriate partners to develop plans to close gaps. Contribute to defining and ensuring security requirements are met based on BofA standards and policies. Incorporate architecture components including threat models, diagrams, and technology requirements into solution development. Utilize network, virtualization, and datacenter technologies to support deployment strategies. Work across technology teams to understand and deliver system requirements. Build and improve processes supporting system transformation, quality controls, dependency management, and workload management. Perform and implement test suites including integration, regression, and performance testing. Analyze test reports, identify issues, and triage root causes. Document and communicate deployment, maintenance, support, and business functionality requirements. Adhere to team delivery and release processes and cadence. Required Qualifications: 5+ years of hands-on experience with Cisco ISE and Cisco SNA in enterprise environments. Experience designing and troubleshooting distributed Cisco ISE deployments (PAN, PSN, MnT nodes). Experience with 802.1X authentication (wired and wireless) and MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB). Experience with NetFlow/IPFIX analysis, behavioral analytics, East-West traffic visibility, insider threat detection, data exfiltration detection, and threat hunting. Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical business owners. Experience working in large enterprise environments. Desired Qualifications: Strong understanding of TCP/IP, Routing and Switching, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, and RADIUS. Experience with Cisco Catalyst, Nexus, and wireless infrastructure. Experience with packet capture and protocol analysis using Wireshark. Exposure to Skyhigh Secure Web Gateway (SWG). Exposure to proxy policy categories. Skills: Influence Result Orientation Solution Design Stakeholder Management Technical Strategy Development Access and Identity Management Critical Thinking Cyber Security Information Systems Management Risk Management Collaboration DevOps Practices Financial Management Solution Delivery Process Test Engineering This job will be open and accepting applications for a minimum of seven days from the date it was posted. Shift: 1st shift (United States of America) Hours Per Week: 40

new_matches.description: Key Responsibilities Deploy, configure, and manage next-generation firewalls, including Palo Alto NGFW and Checkpoint Firewall, ensuring optimal performance and security enforcement. Implement and maintain microsegmentation policies using platforms like Akamai Gaudicore to restrict lateral movement and enhance network security. Perform day-to-day operational tasks for network security infrastructure, including rule base management, troubleshooting connectivity issues, and incident response. Utilize network security policy management platforms such as Tufin for auditing, compliance, and streamlining firewall change management processes. Optimize firewall rule sets and ensure compliance with security policies using tools like AlgoSec, providing clear visibility and automation for network access changes. Collaborate with clients to understand their network security requirements, design appropriate solutions, and provide ongoing technical support and guidance. Monitor network traffic and security events to identify potential threats, analyze vulnerabilities, and recommend proactive security measures. Contribute to the continuous improvement of network security posture through regular assessments, configuration reviews, and adherence to security best practices. Requirements 1-3 years of practical experience in network security engineering or operations. B.Tech or M.Tech degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Demonstrated experience with firewall deployment, configuration, and management. Understanding and practical experience with network security posture management. Experience in designing and implementing microsegmentation solutions. Proficiency in network protocols, routing, switching, and common network security concepts. Ability to troubleshoot complex network security issues effectively. Nice-to-Have Hands-on experience with Palo Alto NGFW for operation and management. Familiarity with Checkpoint Firewall administration. Experience operating and managing Akamai Gaudicore for microsegmentation. Practical experience with Tufin for network security policy orchestration and auditing. Knowledge of AlgoSec for security policy management and automation. 🔔 Stay updated on our latest job openings and industry insights by following us on LinkedIn: eSec Forte® Technologies!

You will own and advance our security posture across endpoints, networks, cloud environments, and identity systems while contributing to compliance efforts including NIST 800-171 and ITAR/EAR requirements. This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week or fully remote from an approved U.S. location. Responsibilities Design, deploy, and manage endpoint security solutions (EDR/XDR) across macOS and Windows fleets, including policy tuning, alert triage, and incident response Own network security architecture including firewall rule management, IDS/IPS tuning, network segmentation, and VPN infrastructure Lead vulnerability management program — run scans, prioritize findings, coordinate remediation with engineering teams, and track closure metrics Administer and harden IAM systems (Okta, AWS IAM) including SSO integrations, conditional access policies, privilege access reviews, and lifecycle automation Develop and maintain security monitoring and alerting using SIEM platforms, building detection rules and response playbooks Conduct security assessments of new tools, vendors, and architectural changes before deployment Drive cloud security posture management across AWS environments including IAM policies, S3 bucket security, security group reviews, and CloudTrail/GuardDuty monitoring Support CMMC Level 2 and NIST SP 800-171 compliance — maintain SSP control narratives, collect evidence, and prepare for assessments Develop and deliver security awareness training and phishing simulation campaigns Lead or support incident response activities including containment, forensic analysis, root cause determination, and post-incident reporting Maintain and improve data loss prevention (DLP) controls for CUI and sensitive data Contribute to security policy development and keep documentation current as the environment evolves Qualifications 5+ years of experience in information security or security engineering roles Strong hands-on experience with endpoint detection and response platforms (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or similar) Demonstrated experience managing enterprise vulnerability scanning tools (Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, or similar) Deep understanding of identity and access management principles and hands-on Okta or Azure AD administration Proficiency with cloud security in AWS (IAM, VPC, Security Groups, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Config) Experience with SIEM platforms (Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic, or similar) for log analysis and detection engineering Solid networking knowledge — firewalls, proxies, DNS security, network segmentation, packet analysis Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as NIST 800-171, CMMC, SOC 2, or ISO 27001 Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to convey risk and technical findings to both engineers and leadership Nice-to-Have Skills Relevant certifications (CISSP, GIAC, CEH, AWS Security new_matches.title: Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer (m/w/d)
new_matches.description: Wir bei der EDEKA IT sind das Herzstück des digitalen Wandels im EDEKA-Verbund. Als leistungsstarkes Team entwickeln wir IT-Strategien, -Infrastrukturen und -Dienstleistungen für alle Handelsbereiche des EDEKA-Verbunds in ganz Deutschland. Wir bündeln unsere Kompetenzen, um innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln und umzusetzen. So treiben wir den Handel von morgen voran - vielleicht schon bald gemeinsam mit dir? In deiner Rolle als Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer (m/w/d) am Standort Hamburg kannst du bei uns deinen ganz persönlichen Beitrag zu unseren Zielen leisten. Deine Aufgaben In unserer B2C-Welt entwickeln wir die EDEKA App fortlaufend mit viel Freude weiter und brauchen im Rahmen größerer Changes nun Unterstützung im Bereich Infrastruktur! Wenn du dich entscheidest, Teil unseres agilen, crossfunktionalen und ambitionierten Teams zu sein, gehört Folgendes zu deinen Aufgaben: Betrieb, Weiterentwicklung und Automatisierung unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur in Azure Verwaltung und Ausbau unserer Infrastructure-as-Code-Basis mit Terraform Betreuung von Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) mit Docker-basierten Anwendungen Verwaltung und Optimierung von Azure Managed PostgreSQL, Blob Storage und EventHub, sowie MongoDB Atlas Unterstützung beim Deployment und Betrieb von Anwendungen auf Basis von Java und Spring Boot Aufbau, Pflege und Verbesserung von CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitHub Actions Monitoring, Alerting und Troubleshooting mit Datadog Analyse und Behebung von Performance-, Verfügbarkeits- und Sicherheitsproblemen Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungsteams zur Verbesserung von Deployment-, Betriebs- und Observability-Prozessen Integration und Betrieb von Schnittstellen zu AWS-Umgebungen und Keycloak Betreuung und Konfiguration von CDN- und Security-Komponenten Mitwirken bei Themen wie Cloud Security, Secrets Management, Backup/Restore und Incident Response Dein Profil Du hast ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung mit IT-Bezug erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder verfügst über eine gleichwertige Qualifikation. Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung im Betrieb von (hybriden) Cloud-Infrastrukturen mit (vorzugsweise Azure) - gerne auch in Themen wie AKS, Managed PostgreSQL, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Azure Container Registry und EventHub. Du verfügst über solides Praxiswissen im Umgang mit Kubernetes-Clustern, Docker bzw. containerisierten Anwendungen im Allgemeinen sowie in der Arbeit mit Terraform bzw. Infrastructure as Code Du besitzt Kenntnisse im Aufbau und Betrieb von CI/CD-Pipelines (idealerweise mit GitHub Actions), hast ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Netzwerk-, Security- und Cloud-Architektur-Themen und pflegst einen sicheren Umgang mit Linux, Shell-Scripting und typischen DevOps-Werkzeugen Du verfügst über Kenntnisse im Betrieb relationaler Datenbanken, idealerweise PostgreSQL Du bringst Erfahrung mit Monitoring- und Observability-Tools mit, idealerweise Datadog Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (CEFR-Level C1 oder höher). Zusätzlich freuen wir uns über Kenntnisse in folgenden Bereichen: Keycloak, OAuth2, OpenID Connect oder Identity- und Access-Management Azure Front Door, CDN-Konfigurationen oder Web Application Firewalls Java, Spring Boot, NodeJS oder anderen Web-Application-Stacks IT Security Hardening, Secrets Management und Cloud Governance Backup-, Recovery- und Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepte Unser Angebot Work-Life-Balance: Profitiere von 30 Tagen Urlaub und der Möglichkeit zum anteiligen mobilen Arbeiten (i.d.R. 2 Tage pro Woche). Einfluss: Du gestaltest die IT des Marktführers im Lebensmitteleinzelhandel in Deutschland. Finanzieller Anreiz & weitere Angebote: Freue dich über ein attraktives Gehalt, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, kostenloses Gehaltskonto sowie weitere Benefits & Angebote. Gesamtheitliche Entwicklung (fachlich & persönlich): Dich erwarten bei uns verschiedene Weiterbildungsangebote wie z. B. digitale Lernplattformen und die Möglichkeit, an Fachkonferenzen teilzunehmen. Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement: Unser Gesundheitsmanagement kümmert sich um dein Wohlbefinden am Arbeitsplatz und darüber hinaus. Kultur & Zusammenarbeit: Wir ermöglichen dir einen optimalen Start in unserem Unternehmen und legen viel Wert auf ein gutes Onboarding, damit du direkt durchstarten und durch unsere verschiedenen Communities und Netzwerke von Anfang an mitgestalten kannst. Interessiert? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung, die mindestens folgendes enthalten sollte: Lebenslauf inkl. eindeutiger Angaben zu deiner Qualifikation und Motivation für die Position. Ggf. Arbeitsproben, Links zu Portfolio / GitHub / Social Media Plattformen etc. Angaben zu deiner Gehaltsvorstellung (brutto p.a.) Mögliches Startdatum bzw. Kündigungsfrist Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Willkommen sind bei uns alle Menschen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Behinderung, Religion, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung. Kontakt EDEKA IT Stiftung & Co. OHG Bewerbungsmanagement New-York-Ring 6 22297 Hamburg Weitere Informationen zu den Einstiegsmöglichkeiten und zur Karriere bei EDEKA IT für Professionals findest du unter: https://it.edeka/professionals/

As a Linux System Administrator, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the security and operational resilience of FEMA's Linux-based infrastructure. You will work in a dynamic environment, collaborating with cybersecurity professionals, system owners, and enterprise administrators to implement and maintain secure server configurations across on-premises and hybrid environments. Your efforts will directly contribute to safeguarding FEMA's mission-critical systems and data. The Linux System Administrator will be responsible for securing Linux-based infrastructure supporting system reliability, hardening, patching, logging, and assessment readiness across on-premises and hybrid environments. This position requires leveraging DISA STIGs or CIS Benchmarks to reduce attack surfaces and implement security controls and configurations. The Linux System Administrator will configure firewalls, access controls, and harden system services while performing regular patching, software upgrades, and hotfixes on Linux servers. This role ensures high availability and uptime through proactive monitoring of system performance, health, and capacity. Responsibilities The Linux System Administrator will secure Linux-based infrastructure for the FEMA enterprise and leverage DISA STIGs or CIS Benchmarks to reduce attack surfaces while implementing security controls and configurations across Linux systems. This position requires configuring firewalls, access controls, and hardening system services, as well as performing regular patching, software upgrades, and hotfixes on Linux servers. The Linux System Administrator will remediate vulnerabilities and ensure system integrity while planning and testing patches to avoid operational disruptions. Responsibilities include ensuring high availability and uptime for mission-critical systems, proactively monitoring system performance, health, and capacity, and supporting business continuity requirements. The position involves implementing redundancy measures and preventing system failures, managing user identities, authentication, and authorization, and supporting ICAM tools, LDAP, and privileged access management. The Linux System Administrator will implement principle of least privilege and maintain system logging for auditing and compliance. This position requires supporting vulnerability remediation and conducting security assessments while researching and maintaining proficiency in tools, techniques, countermeasures, and trends in computer and network vulnerabilities, data hiding, and network and device security and encryption. The Linux System Administrator will maintain technical documentation for all administrative actions. A focus on continuous growth. Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy. Job Summary: Acrisure is seeking a Sr. Cloud Engineer based in our Infrastructure Operations group that is responsible for supporting enterprise cloud infrastructure services with a primary focus on Microsoft Azure. This role supports cloud resource provisioning, infrastructure automation, monitoring, governance, and operational readiness across cloud and hybrid environments. The Cloud Engineer partners with network, telephony, EUC, operations, security, business systems, and business teams to deliver scalable, reliable, well-governed cloud services that align with enterprise standards and business objectives. There is a heavy emphasis on Azure Virtual Desktop technology. Responsibilities: Very heavy focus on Azure Virtual Desktop, leveraging Nerdio and FxLogic. Support Microsoft Azure infrastructure services, including virtual machines, storage, DNS, identity integration, and platform services. Provision and manage cloud resources using approved standards for subscriptions, management groups, resource groups, tagging, naming conventions, and environment classification. Support Infrastructure as Code and automation toolkits to improve consistency, repeatability, compliance, and speed of cloud deployments. Maintain security controls for cloud environments, including least-privilege access, privileged identity management, role-based access control, encryption, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement. Partner with observability and operations teams to configure actionable monitoring, alerting, dashboards, telemetry, escalation paths, and operational reporting for cloud resources. Support cloud lifecycle management activities, including operating system upgrade planning, patching coordination, backup alignment, disaster recovery readiness, capacity planning, and cost optimization. Collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, architecture, and business stakeholders to gather requirements, validate technical designs, and deliver cloud solutions aligned with enterprise standards. Participate in troubleshooting and tier-three escalation support for cloud infrastructure incidents, performance issues, connectivity problems, and service reliability concerns. Create and maintain operational documentation, SOPs, deployment guides, diagrams, runbooks, and knowledge transfer materials for cloud platforms and services Requirements : Three or more years of experience supporting cloud infrastructure services in an enterprise environment. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure administration, including compute, storage, identity integration, monitoring, backup, and governance capabilities. Strong understanding of cloud computing principles, including Virtual Desktop & IaaS Strong understand of PaaS, serverless services, virtualization, networking, security, scalability, resiliency, and cost management. Familiarity with Azure Policy, management groups, subscriptions, resource tagging, RBAC, privileged access, and cloud governance practices. Experience supporting cloud monitoring and observability tools such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, or similar platforms. Ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues across cloud, identity, operating system, and application layers. Strong documentation, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work across technical and business teams. Proactive, ownership-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced enterprise technology environment. Strong commitment to secure, reliable, scalable, and well-documented infrastructure services. Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on automation, standardization, repeatable processes, and operational maturity. Ability to balance project delivery, operational support, stakeholder communication, and production reliability priorities. Education and Experience: Relevant Microsoft certifications to include, but not limited to Azure Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Security Engineer, or Azure DevOps Engineer are preferred. Candidates should be comfortable with an on-site presence to support collaboration, team leadership, and cross-functional partnership. Our benefits are designed to support every dimension of your life, from your health and finances to your family and future. Employee Benefits We also offer our employees a comprehensive suite of benefits and perks, including: Physical Wellness: Comprehensive medical insurance, dental insurance, and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; fertility benefits; wellness resources; and paid sick time. Mental Wellness: Generous paid time off and holidays; Employee Assistance Program (EAP); and a complimentary Calm app subscription. Financial Wellness: Immediate vesting in a 401(k) plan; Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options; commuter benefits; and employee discount programs. Family Care: Paid maternity leave and paid paternity leave (including for adoptive parents); legal plan options; and pet insurance coverage. … and so much more!
